claims.statement: Taxila preserves several successive settlements. The Bhir mound contains the remains of an early historic town; Sirkap and Sirsukh belong to later phases. Its position brought it into contact with Persia, the Greek world and Central Asia. Buddhist monasteries and monuments were part of its changing urban landscape.
Taxila: 500 BCE to 200 CE. 500 BCE–200 CE is an editorial window within a much longer history. The point marks Bhir Mound, one component of the UNESCO property, not all Taxila or a political border.
